name: oracle-firefox
description: Run durable, Pro-verified ChatGPT consultations through one shared Firefox broker from Codex, Claude, Claudex, or Desktop.

interface.shortDescription: Durable ChatGPT Pro consultation through Firefox.
interface.longDescription: Oracle Firefox runs one authenticated Firefox and one durable broker per user. It safely queues standalone, project, and existing-chat messages, verifies Pro before sending, survives client timeouts and broker restarts, supports structured local-evidence follow-ups, and downloads generated files read-only.
defaultPrompt: Get a Firefox-backed second opinion on this code.
Ask ChatGPT to review these files in a project through Firefox.
Continue an existing ChatGPT conversation through Firefox.
